product_metadata.title: Easy Load - Screw-On
features: Control 3 & 5 gallon water bottle splash when turning onto dispenser
No-splash means no need to mop floor
Fits most standard water bottles and dispensers
Get 2 Easy Loads to assure you have a clean replacement
description: This clever design holds back water as you turn over your 3 or 5 gallon water bottle onto your cooler or other water dispenser. Insert the tube inside your bottle and screw it on. As you turn the bottle the ball inside the tube is forced down blocking the water flow. Once the bottle is set into position the ball floats upward in the tube, allowing free flow of water. A single Easy Load cap can be moved from bottle to bottle as you refill your dispenser. With this dishwasher safe product, having two Easy Loads assures you have a clean one. This 48mm screw top fits most 3 and 5 gallon water bottles and is considered a standard size. For reference, outside dimension for the bottle opening would be 1.889 inches. If you have a regular cap for the bottle the outside dimension of that cap is about 2 inches. If your water cooler has a center post, this post can not be taller than 2.5 inches for this product to work. Please measure. GE coolers often have a taller center post.
